transcript.text: So, I was talking to a lead gen business
a few weeks back. They were having this
issue where the clients they were
bringing on weren't working the leads
well. I said, "Well, one of the easiest
things you can do is simply add dummy
leads to the leads that you give them,
and then you can measure how frequently,
how quickly, and actually listen and
record the scripting that they say with
you or your team. And if you tell them
up front, 'By the way, in the first 10
leads, we're going to give you one of
our own dummy leads,' it sets an
expectation that they actually have to
do work in order to get the result."
